messages:
maya: FYI: after the int8 bringup on quant4b we see a ~12% drop on anchorset pass rate. Failing examples concentrated in policy + finance intents. Need to refresh golden and relabel high-impact samples. cc @owen @zara :warning:

owen: Can you paste the failing examples / quick metrics?

maya: Quick numbers: anchorset n=2400; pass->fail ~288. ~55% of fails are high-confidence diffs (>=0.9) between float32 and int8 outputs. We're extracting a 200-sample high-priority batch to relabel. snippet of the extraction command:```python
# sample by delta score and high confidence mismatches
python tools/sample_golden.py --dataset anchorset --filter "score_delta>0.12 and conf_float>=0.9" --limit 200 --tag relabel_quant4b_int8
```

labeler-bot: Queued 200 items to curation:golden_relabel_queue (priority=high). ETA for batch: ~2h.

zara: Are we doing binary pass/fail or updating the rubric? Last time quant changed wording and we needed rubric tweaks.

maya: Binary for now (does model output match the golden expected answer exactly). If ambiguous mark `ambiguous` and add a one-line comment with why. Short rubric: 1) exact match -> PASS 2) paraphrase but semantically same -> PASS 3) hallucinated facts or missing obligation -> FAIL 4) ambiguous/incomplete -> AMBIGUOUS.

sam: I'll run a small canary relabel run and re-eval once the batch is in. @jen can you spin up labeler rotation (3 people)?

jen: Assigning labelers: @kevin @anita @lia — they're on standby. Labelers please use doc `golden_relabel_v2` and follow the inline examples. Re-label cap per person: 120 (we'll split 200 as 80/60/60).

kevin: On it. Quick Q — what's QA acceptance threshold?

jen: Need >=95% agreement with majority for sample to be accepted. Any 2+ disagreement -> escalate to @maya for adjudication.

owen: After relabel, run regression harness: `scripts/regress.py --models float32,quant4b-int8 --dataset anchorset --out out/regress_int8.json`

maya: Plan: relabel today, run harness EOD. If regression persists we'll rollback int8 canary. Sam will coordinate the rollback timeline. :thumbsup:

sam: Canary rollback command (hold until I authorise): `deploy rollback quant4b-int8 --tag canary-2026-03-21`

labeler-bot: Label batch status: assigned to 3 labelers (kevin/anita/lia). 60/60/80 distribution, progress updates will be posted here.

zara: Also log diffs to eval dashboard under `quant:onboard/anchorset-int8` and link to PM ticket so product sees trend.

maya: Added dashboard folder and will paste CSV diff + a handful of representative examples to #eng-ml when harness completes.

labeler-bot: Progress update: 45/200 completed; 12 marked ambiguous; 2 escalated to maya.

jen: Thanks all — labelers remember to include the `golden_relabel_v2` tag on comments for easy filtering.

sam: Once labels land I'll kick off regress and post results. If float32 -> int8 delta > 8% on any priority slice we trigger rollback.

maya: Keeping PMs and infra in the loop. Thanks everyone.
